LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_NoContacts: no allied neolithic or medieval settlements nearby
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_ContactUnavailable: That settlement contact is no longer available.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_DialogDescription: Choose one caller and up to two helpers. Melee controls the blanket and fuel; Social is the caller's charisma carried by the smoke pattern.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_OutcomeBands: Above 50%: warriors answer now. Above 30%: a delayed answer. From 15% through 30%: noticed but misunderstood. Below 15%: unnoticed.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_TooMany: Only two helpers can join the caller.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_Delayed: The signal was understood. Warriors may arrive later.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_Misunderstood: The smoke was noticed but misunderstood. No warriors are coming.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_Unnoticed: The signal failed to be noticed. No warriors are coming.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_Interrupted: The smoke signal was interrupted before it could be understood.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_NoResponse: The allied faction can no longer answer this signal.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_AidFailed: The signal was understood, but no warriors could answer.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_AidCooldown: The allies are still recovering from their last aid mission. Try again in {0}.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_InvalidParticipants: The signal needs one to three available adult colonists.
LanguageData.ImmersiveSignalFire_NoWorkCells: There are not enough distinct reachable places around the signal fire.
